values.note: The 14-night limit (14 consecutive days in any 30) applies March 1-October 31; long stays are allowed November-February with skirting, a hydrant cover and a heated hose, and no soft-side or pop-up campers then. The weekend minimum must be Friday/Saturday or Saturday/Sunday. Unreserved sites may be taken on arrival after calling the camp host. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 2 pm.

note: City of Lawson campground at the south arm of the 25-acre Lawson City Lake, with a paved lake trail, disc golf and a fishing dock, boat ramp and kayak dock on the lake. Generators are not allowed; a tent may go up only beside an RV. The Raum Road bridge is closed until it is replaced (posted 2026): approach by the gravel 204th St / Tri-County Line Rd route from the west or the paved KK Hwy / 208th St route from the east. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30-45 (on-season $35 weeknight / $45 weekend, off-season $30), 21 full-hookup sites, year-round, online booking; added 50A (engine's only electric type), laundry/flush toilets, weekend 2-night minimum, 14-night on-season limit, booking URL. Lakeview kept. Raum Rd bridge closure into the note. Phone flag.
